title: Spartathlon FAQ
claims: The FAQ says a runner who drops out or is eliminated must sign the appropriate declaration and hand in the race number; Spartathlon personnel are responsible for transport onwards to the runner's hotel in Sparta.

The FAQ says all runners may receive assistance from an officially registered support team only at specially designated checkpoints, and the support car must be registered in Athens; bicycles and motorcycles are not allowed.
The FAQ says 400 runners will be accepted and that entry costs €450; no prize money has ever been offered.
The FAQ says applications open on 25 January and close on 25 February, with payment due by 10 June.
